prompt.sw: Kabla ya kuanza kufanyia kazi tatizo, unapaswa kufanya nini?
prompt.en: Before you start work on an issue, what should you do?

label.sw: Kuandika maoni kwenye tatizo kueleza mpango wako
label.en: Comment on the issue with your plan

label.sw: Kufungua mapendekezo matano kwa wakati mmoja
label.en: Open five pull requests at once
Change every file in the project

explanation.sw: Huzuia kazi kurudiwa na humpa mtunzaji nafasi ya kukuongoza.
explanation.en: It avoids duplicate work and lets a maintainer guide you.

prompt.sw: Pendekezo zuri la mabadiliko lina sifa gani?
prompt.en: What makes a good pull request?

label.sw: Wazo moja, maelezo ya nini, kwa nini na jinsi lilivyokaguliwa
label.en: One idea, with what, why and how it was checked

explanation.sw: Mapendekezo madogo na yaliyoelezwa vizuri hukaguliwa haraka.
explanation.en: Small, well-described PRs get reviewed quickly.

prompt.sw: CI imeshindwa kwenye pendekezo lako. Ufanye nini?
prompt.en: CI failed on your pull request. What should you do?

label.sw: Kusoma kumbukumbu, kurekebisha na kusukuma tena
label.en: Read the log, fix it and push again
Close the PR without a word

explanation.sw: Wakaguzi hutarajia ujenzi uliopita kabla ya kukagua.
explanation.en: Reviewers expect a green build before they review.

prompt.sw: Masomo ya Jifunze yako chini ya leseni gani?

explanation.sw: Msimbo ni MIT; masomo ni CC BY-SA 4.0, kama Kujifunza Bitcoin.
explanation.en: Code is MIT; lessons are CC BY-SA 4.0, like Kujifunza Bitcoin.
